messages:
mike_sales: Heads-up — Acme POC seeing intermittent 429s during user-import demo in 20m. Tenant: `acme-prod-poc`.

tara_se: On it. Are the 429s scoped to a route or account-wide? Any log snippets?

mike_sales: Paste from customer: {"status":429,"error":"rate_exceeded","route":"/v1/generate","tokens":4200}. Other endpoints seem ok.

newen_infra: Pulling server logs now. Can you share request pattern: prompt length, concurrency, frequency?

mike_sales: They run 3 parallel sessions, each sends ~6k-token prompts (long upload contexts) and occasional rerank embedding calls.

owen_infra: I see matching entries. Per-route token cap for /v1/generate is hit. Token budget window is 60s with a 10s burst window; their burst usage exceeds the burst_tokens.

tara_se: Quick mitigations: 1) drop client concurrency for demo; 2) temporary per-tenant override to raise burst_tokens; 3) route heavy requests to a larger-token-cap model variant.

mike_sales: Can we do #2 now? How long to apply?

owen_infra: I can push an override in about 5m. Need tenant id and the bump amount. Default burst_tokens=5000; propose 15000 until EOD.

linda_am: Asking customer if temporary bump is acceptable. I'll update.

mike_sales: They approved temporary bump until EOD.

owen_infra: Executing admin override:
```
POST /internal/admin/overrides
{
  "tenant": "acme-prod-poc",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "override": {"burst_tokens": 15000, "expires_in": 14400}
}
```

deploy-bot: override apply job queued -> job id job_8239. status: in_progress.

newen_infra: Job applied. Effective config for acme-prod-poc: burst_tokens=15000, window=60s. Monitor for 5m.

tara_se: Also created quick demo playbook: backoff on the client, route long contexts to rw-gen-large, set prefix cache TTL=30s for repeat flows.

mike_sales: Customer testing — streams resumed, no 429s in last 30s :tada:

owen_infra: Logs show token burn rate dropped after override. There's still periodic rerank embedding spikes; recommend capping those calls.

tara_se: Follow-up: add per-tenant budget alert to catch this pre-demo. I'll raise a task.

linda_am: I'll confirm post-demo whether they want a permanent quota or routing change.

mike_sales: Great — include the token accounting example I shared with the customer in the postmortem so PMs can update docs.

tara_se: Accounting calc for notes:
```
6k tokens/request * 3 concurrent = 18k tokens in flight
burst_window (10s) allowed = 5k default -> immediate exceed
=> need burst_tokens >= in-flight tokens * safety_factor
```

owen_infra: I'll add an admin preview endpoint to show effective per-route budgets for a tenant.

deploy-bot: job job_8239 completed successfully.

mike_sales: Closing thread after demo. Will reopen if customer wants permanent change.
